name: Platinum Vape Live Resin Disposable | Gelato
description: Smooth, flavorful, and ready to go. Platinum’s P1 All-In-One Gelato delivers the creamy, dessert-like flavor Gelato is loved for—sweet berry notes with a silky vanilla finish. As an indica, the effects lean heavy, melting stress and easing the body into calm relaxation while keeping the mind in a blissful haze. The P1 device comes pre-charged and ready to enjoy, making it the perfect grab-and-go option for reliable potency and convenience.
